Name: Doeg
Summary: Doeg the Edomite is named in the title of Psalm 52, the psalm David wrote after Doeg told Saul that David had come to the house of Ahimelech.
KeyStory: Doeg's report to Saul set in motion the slaughter of the priests of Nob, and Psalm 52 answers his treachery with a warning about the fate of those who trust in riches and lies.
LifeLesson: Doeg is a warning that words can kill — informing on the innocent for favour is a betrayal God judges.
